run_benchmark_continuous_batching: run the continuous batching benchmark script with default test configurations and save results to JSON
run_benchmark_continuous_batching_main: run the continuous batching benchmark and save results as the main baseline for future comparison
run_benchmark_continuous_batching_args: run the continuous batching benchmark with custom CLI arguments and parse throughput results
compare_benchmark_results: compare current benchmark results against the most recent main baseline and display diff percentages
find_most_recent_benchmark_file: find the most recent benchmark results JSON file matching a given prefix in the results directory
